operational_limitations: only daily/weekly recurrence and institutional named-event resolution
no durable scheduling or event dispatch
no natural-language model; named phrases registered by explicit institution and revision
no live timezone update or clock authority
TZif POSIX DST footer recurrence unsupported beyond coverage
opt-in single-writer local append-only journal, no fsync or cryptographic authenticity
historical institutional semantics require separately retained matching TZif data for exact UTC replay
journal management not exposed over RPC
impact comparison bounded to 366 civil dates per request; 31 default
local pull watches are not durable subscriptions or push delivery
time.impact.analyze RPC compares institutional revisions using one existing configured rule provider
snapshot archive publication must be explicitly invoked; no automatic tzdb updates, no signed provenance, no rule update subscriptions
snapshot checksums do not authenticate publisher; runtime Adler32 detects accidental corruption only; full SHA-256 is an offline verification step
native v0.8 ooRexx test and full regression rerun remain outstanding due to unavailable ooRexx executable
time validity interval is a standalone predicate, not certificate validation, trusted clock acquisition or TLS/LDAP admission
